Class CharArrayCharStream

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.plugins.compiler.antlr.CharArrayCharStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.antlr.v4.runtime.CharStream, org.antlr.v4.runtime.IntStream
public final class CharArrayCharStream extends Object implements org.antlr.v4.runtime.CharStream
A zero-copy CharStream backed directly by a char[] slice.

Unlike CharStreams.fromString(String), this implementation avoids:

  • Allocating an intermediate String
  • Allocating a CharBuffer
  • Allocating a CodePointBuffer
  • Copying character data (3× in the standard path)

This makes it suitable for per-line tokenization in RSyntaxTextArea where getTokenList() is called for every visible line on every keystroke.

Limitation: Assumes all characters are in the BMP (U+0000–U+FFFF), which is true for assembly language source code.
